notes.title: The Winter Event 2022 is here!
notes.content:
I've been delayed, but after two years it's finally out!  

[b]Explore [/b]Qrizon and the First Layer in search of secrets and stories!  
You can buy the domain, [b]build [/b]a cool place and [b]decorate [/b]it.. If you're [b]curious [/b]enough to find some.. 
Unlock the [b]abilites [/b]of the alchemist wih the sanctuary, [b]change your look[/b] with the garderobe seek for materials.. building isn't free at all. If you encounter some monsters, be sure to be armed enought.  
The [b]Respawn Totems[/b] allows you to come back at a check point and save your progress.  The game is also [b]multiplayer[/b], just give your session ID to your friends! Max 3 players per sessions.  

Controllers are supported

Try to complete the 6 Steam success and send pictures of your hero to the community! 

Happy new year,  
Tamwyn

notes.title: First communication
notes.content:
Hellooo.   
First post since the launch of the Steam page. Thanks for adding the game to the wishlist!   
I'm currently in the review phase and will be going on holiday in a few days. We are polishing the gameplay design with my designer friend Aquilon. We are planning skill trees, classes, etc. Development will resume in September. Until then, if you'd like to join the [url=discord.gg/u3K6fjd] Discord Community[/url], we'd love to have you!  
Some information about the release of Kingdom's Edge:   
[list]      
[*]The date is not yet set, the date on the website is not yet correct.      
[*]We expect the release price to be between $5 and $10.      
[*]The game will evolve over time.      
[*]Due to my studies, development may take some time... but it's coming along! ^^  
[/list]  
This game is close to my heart and I hope to share my passion :)    
See you soon! 

 Tamwyn
